apps.localizedDescription: Free public Lite companion for Apple TV: ultra-low-latency Remote (Touchpad + D-Pad + Vietnamese/English keyboard), wireless 1080p/4K Apple TV screenshots, full tvOS App Library (Kodi .deb auto-conversion, Stremio, Orivio TV, Nuvio TV, Yattee, LiveContainerTV, plus direct HTTPS .ipa/.deb & GitHub sources), and LiveContainerTV-only multi-app hosting using just 1 primary Apple ID (no external .p12 certificates or activation codes required).

versions.localizedDescription:
4AppleTV Lite v1.0.1 (Build 2):
• Synchronized 7-day LiveContainerTV expiry display: Fast misagent profile renewals automatically mirror the renewed .mobileprovision into LiveContainerTV via HouseArrest and push live updates over :8228 (/api/v1/sync-expiry), fixing the 7-day vs 4-day mismatch.
• Retroactive Auto-Healing: Automatically syncs previously refreshed LiveContainerTV hosts as soon as 4AppleTV Lite connects.
• Free public edition — zero activation key, 1 primary Apple ID, 100% LiveContainerTV & BLA protected.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: 4AppleTV Lite discovers, controls, captures screenshots, and sideloads apps inside LiveContainerTV on Apple TVs over your local Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: 4AppleTV Lite saves copies of captured Apple TV screenshots to your iPhone Photo Library when you choose Save to Photos.
